facts.text: Under the Huntingdon Plan, all full-time undergraduate students receive a laptop to keep at graduation, books, and senior travel-study opportunities within tuition.

sources.title: Huntingdon Admission Offers Preview Day
sources.quote: Through the Huntingdon Plan, each full-time undergraduate student is provided a laptop computer for use all four years and theirs to keep at graduation; senior-year travel-study opportunities; books and information resources for fall and spring terms
